title: LLMs as Planning Formalizers: A Survey for Leveraging Large Language Models to Construct Automated Planning Models
best_for_zh: 探索大语言模型如何辅助长程规划与形式化规划模型构建的读者。
one_line: A Findings ACL 2025 survey of using language models to formalize planning specifications for automated planners.
综述如何借助大语言模型构造和改进自动规划模型。
why: It clarifies the boundary between generating a plan in prose and constructing a formal model that a planner can reliably use.
inclusion_reason: A peer-reviewed survey explaining how language models can support formal model construction for automated planning.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Language models can be strong at natural-language tasks yet struggle with long-horizon planning that needs structured reasoning. This survey asks how they can help construct and refine formal planning specifications so dependable automated planners can be used downstream. It is a Findings ACL 2025 survey of research at the intersection of NLP and automated planning, not a new planner implementation.

The key distinction is between describing a plan in fluent language and providing a formal problem representation that a planner can act on. A project may succeed at the first while failing at the second. Read this survey when deciding whether the main difficulty lies in interpreting a specification, formalizing it, or solving an already formal planning problem.

语言模型擅长多种自然语言任务，却常难以完成需要结构化推理的长程规划。本文考察如何让它们构造和改进形式化规划规格，再交给可靠的自动规划器使用。论文发表于 Findings ACL 2025，综述 NLP 与自动规划交叉处的研究，而不是发布新的规划器实现。

关键区别在于：用流畅语言描述计划，与提供规划器可执行的形式问题表示不是一回事。项目可能前者做得好、后者失败。读本文时可判断困难主要在理解规格、把规格形式化，还是求解已形式化的问题。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The central idea is to treat a language model as a planning formalizer rather than as the final planner. It surveys ways to turn or refine planning specifications into forms usable by off-the-shelf automated planning systems, then discusses methods and challenges. This distinction matters because fluent plan text is not the same thing as a formal model a solver can execute reliably.

This framing separates responsibilities: the language model handles natural-language interpretation or refinement, while the planner operates on a formal representation. It gives readers a way to locate errors at the handoff rather than attributing every failure to planning ability. The survey is useful for comparing systems that use similar planners but differ in how the planning model is constructed.

核心思想是把语言模型看作规划形式化工具，而不是最终规划器。论文综述如何把规划规格转换或改进为现成自动规划系统可使用的形式，并讨论方法和挑战。这一区分很重要：流畅的计划文字不等于求解器能可靠执行的形式化模型。

这一框架分开责任：语言模型负责自然语言解释或改进，规划器处理形式表示。它让读者能在交接处定位错误，而非把每次失败都归因于规划能力。比较同用规划器、却采用不同建模方式的系统时尤其有用。

title: Method
方法
html:
As a survey, the paper synthesizes existing work instead of training one model. Its conceptual pipeline starts from a planning specification, uses a language model for formalization or refinement, and then relies on an automated planner as the downstream system. The official abstract does not report a shared dataset, codebase, reward model, prompt design, or sampling budget, so those must be recovered from individual cited papers.

For each primary system, record the natural-language input, target formal representation, model intervention, planner, and success criterion. This minimal pipeline makes the survey's comparison operational. It also prevents a result from being interpreted as a general planning improvement when it may instead rely on a particular formal language, planner capability, or problem specification.

作为综述，论文综合已有研究，而不是训练单一模型。其概念流程从规划规格开始，借助语言模型做形式化或改进，再由自动规划器作为下游系统。官方摘要没有报告统一数据集、代码库、奖励模型、提示设计或采样预算，相关信息应从各篇被引用论文中获取。

对每个原始系统，可记录自然语言输入、目标形式表示、模型干预、规划器和成功判据。这个最小流程能让本文的比较变得可操作，也避免把结果误读为一般规划提升，而忽略特定形式语言、规划器或问题规格的影响。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper's evidence is an in-depth, systematic review of the current research and its stated focus on methodologies, critical challenges, and future directions. The official abstract grounds the discussion in the practical objective of supporting reliable off-the-shelf planners. It does not claim a newly measured performance gain, so readers should use it to compare designs and then inspect primary experiments for quantitative evidence.

Its evidence supports a map of methods and failure points, not a shared performance ranking. A reported plan outcome may reflect both the quality of formalization and the planner selected after it. When a claim matters, inspect the original evaluation to learn whether it checks the formal model itself, the resulting plan, or only a final task outcome.

论文的证据来自对当前研究的深入系统回顾，以及对方法、关键挑战和未来方向的明确整理。官方摘要把讨论落在支持可靠现成规划器这一实际目标上。它没有声称新的性能提升，因此读者应先用它比较设计，再查看原始实验获取量化证据。

它的证据支撑的是方法与失败点地图，而非统一性能排名。一个计划结果可能同时取决于形式化质量和后续规划器。对重要主张，应查原始评测到底检查了形式模型、产生的计划，还是只检查最终任务结果。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Its contribution is a timely synthesis that places language models in the role of constructing and refining planning models for automated planning. What is new is the coherent framing of this connection between NLP and planning, not a new planning algorithm. The paper is most useful for recognizing where a system's apparent planning success depends on formalization quality rather than on the solver alone.

The contribution changes the question a reader asks about an LLM-planning system: not simply whether it outputs a plausible plan, but whether it creates a representation a reliable solver can use. That perspective makes the handoff measurable and exposes hidden assumptions. It is a conceptual contribution, so a specific method's empirical advantage must still be established by its primary paper.

论文的贡献是及时整合相关研究，把语言模型放在为自动规划构造和改进规划模型的位置。新意在于连贯地刻画 NLP 与规划之间的联系，而不是提出新的规划算法。它有助于辨认一个系统看似成功的规划，究竟依赖形式化质量，还是仅依赖求解器本身。

它改变的是读者的问题：不仅问模型是否输出看似合理的计划，更问它是否构造了可靠求解器可用的表示。这让交接变得可测量，也暴露隐藏假设。具体方法的经验优势仍需由其原始论文建立。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Formal planning is sensitive to specification mistakes: a strong solver can return a valid solution to the wrong formal problem. Long-horizon tasks also remain difficult for language models, as the authors emphasize. Since the surveyed systems may use different planning languages, planners, and task settings, their outcomes should not be treated as directly interchangeable.

This means final plan validity is necessary but may not be sufficient for judging a system against the intended natural-language task. A formally valid result can preserve an earlier interpretation error. The survey does not impose one common representation or measurement protocol, so comparisons should retain the specification language, planner, and definition of successful goal achievement used by each study.

形式化规划对规格错误很敏感：再强的求解器也可能为错误的形式化问题给出有效解。作者也强调，长程任务对语言模型依旧困难。被综述系统可能使用不同的规划语言、规划器和任务设置，因此其结果不应被视为可以直接互换。

最终计划有效，是必要条件，却未必足以说明它符合原始自然语言任务；形式化前的解释错误可能被完整保留。本文没有规定统一表示或测量协议，比较时应保留各研究采用的规格语言、规划器和目标达成定义。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Use this paper when deciding whether a planning project needs a language model to write plans, to build a formal model, or both. It gives readers vocabulary for separating natural-language interpretation from formal planning and for identifying the handoff to an automated planner. It is especially valuable for projects where reliability depends on a planner checking a formal representation.

Use its framing to write a system specification before selecting tools: define what information enters in language, what formal object must be produced, which planner consumes it, and what outcome counts as success. This prevents an interface decision from being hidden inside a broad claim about planning. The cited literature then supplies concrete methods suitable for the chosen representation.

当你需要判断规划项目是让语言模型写计划、构造形式化模型，还是两者兼用时，可以读这篇论文。它提供了区分自然语言理解与形式规划的术语，也说明了自动规划器介入的位置。若项目的可靠性依赖规划器检查形式表示，这篇论文尤其有价值。

可先据此写系统规格：哪些信息以语言进入、必须产出什么形式对象、由哪个规划器消费、什么结果算成功。这样接口选择不会被藏在笼统的规划主张里。被引文献再提供适合所选表示的具体方法。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
Read the motivation on long-horizon planning first, then focus on the formalizer role and the challenges of deployment frameworks. For every primary system you inspect, record the input specification, the target formal language, the planner used, and the criterion for a successful plan. That record reveals whether the claimed capability is planning, formalization, or both.

Add a note on where each evaluation checks correctness: before formalization, after formalization, or after planner execution. This makes comparison more precise because failures at those points have different causes. Finish with the future-directions discussion only after the pipeline is clear, treating it as a guide to unresolved design questions rather than a catalogue of solved problems.

建议先读长程规划的动机，再重点阅读形式化工具的角色和部署框架的挑战。检查任一原始系统时，记录输入规格、目标形式语言、所用规划器和成功计划的判据。这些记录能说明其声称的能力究竟是规划、形式化，还是两者兼有。

还应记录每项评测在哪个位置检查正确性：形式化前、形式化后，还是规划器执行后。不同位置的失败原因不同，因此比较会更精确。流程清楚后再读未来方向，把它作为未解设计问题的提示，而非已解决问题的清单。

title: Citation
引用
html:
Marcus Tantakoun, Christian Muise, and Xiaodan Zhu. 2025. LLMs as Planning Formalizers: A Survey for Leveraging Large Language Models to Construct Automated Planning Models. Findings of ACL 2025, pages 25167–25188. https://aclanthology.org/2025.findings-acl.1291/

Use the ACL Anthology record for the official title, authors, venue, pages, and DOI. Cite this survey for its synthesis of language-model formalization and automated planning. When discussing a specific formal language, planner, task domain, system design, or measured result, cite the primary work as well, because this survey does not introduce a shared implementation or experiment.

Marcus Tantakoun、Christian Muise、Xiaodan Zhu。2025。《LLMs as Planning Formalizers: A Survey for Leveraging Large Language Models to Construct Automated Planning Models》。Findings of ACL 2025，25167–25188 页。https://aclanthology.org/2025.findings-acl.1291/

正式题名、作者、会议、页码与 DOI 应以 ACL Anthology 为准。本文适合引用其对语言模型形式化与自动规划的综合。讨论具体形式语言、规划器、任务域、系统设计或实测结果时，也应引用原始研究，因为本文没有发布统一实现或实验。
